title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
description: Implement the RandomizedSet class to support insert, remove, and getRandom in O(1) average time.
pseudocode:
1. map = {}
2. list = []
3. insert(val): if val in map: return false; list.push(val); map[val] = list.length - 1; return true
4. remove(val): if val not in map: return false; last = list[list.length - 1]; idx = map[val]; list[idx] = last; map[last] = idx; list.pop(); delete map[val]; return true
5. getRandom(): return list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)]

steps.note: Insert 10 into the set. Added to list and map.
Insert 20 into the set. Appended to list.
Remove 10. Replace 10 with last element (20), then pop.
